Entertainment & game day

Charlie's is where Somers Point watches the game. Phillies, Eagles, Flyers, and whatever else is on that matters — every screen in the place, sound up for the big ones.

Trivia night

A regular fixture and a genuinely good time — regulars rate it highly. Call ahead for this week's start time, and get here early if you want a table.

Live entertainment

Music through the week in season. The schedule moves around, so ring the bar and ask who's on this weekend.

Every game on

Screens throughout the front bar and dining room. Phillies, Eagles, Flyers, Sixers, plus the fights and the big college games.

Game day food

Wings by the thirty, tenders, potato skins and Old Bay fries. Order for the table before kickoff and save yourself the wait.

What's on this week?

Our schedule changes often enough that printing it here would only make it wrong. The bar always knows — give us a ring, or follow along on Facebook and Instagram where we post the week ahead.
